ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Print/PDF with at least one medication filled throws 'ReferenceError: primaryClinic is not defined'. Identifier is used at line 303 but never declared/fetched — the /api/clinics fetch + state setter are missing.

action_items: Fix PrescriptionWriter.js: declare `primaryClinic` state and fetch from GET /api/clinics (mirror the pattern likely used in Invoices.js). Example: const [primaryClinic, setPrimaryClinic] = useState(null); useEffect(() => { axios.get(`${BACKEND}/api/clinics`).then(r => setPrimaryClinic((r.data || []).find(c => c.is_primary) || r.data?.[0] || null)); }, []); — then handlePrint will pass a real clinic letterhead instead of crashing.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/invoices.py L180-L181 — leftover placeholder `if current_user.get('role') == 'receptionist' and any(False for _ in []): pass` is dead code; remove for clarity.

routes/invoices.py L141-L146 — find_one_and_update with `return_document=True` works in Motor (maps True→ReturnDocument.AFTER) but is fragile across driver versions; prefer `from pymongo import ReturnDocument; return_document=ReturnDocument.AFTER` for explicit correctness. Currently functioning — concurrency test confirmed two parallel POSTs produced INV-N and INV-N+1.

routes/invoices.py L189 — POST validates `amount_paid <= total + 0.01`, but creating with payment_status='paid' is permitted even when amount_paid=0 (no consistency check). Consider rejecting/normalizing: if payment_status='paid' require amount_paid==total (PUT path has same gap).

routes/invoices.py — receptionist-owned scoping uses `resolve_owner_id` on GET/POST/PUT and `current_user['id']` (must be doctor) on DELETE via require_doctor_or_owner. Verified end-to-end: receptionist-created invoice was visible to parent doctor and deletable only by doctor.
routes/invoices.py — list_invoices applies `client_phone` as exact-match; UI search-by-phone may want a $regex or normalization. Out-of-scope minor.
Frontend PrescriptionWriter.js — primaryClinic referenced but never declared (HIGH, listed above).

rca of the issue: PrescriptionWriter Print bug RCA: handlePrint() at line 296 calls renderPrescriptionHTML({ clinic: primaryClinic, ... }) but `primaryClinic` is never declared as state nor fetched. Likely the dev intended to mirror Invoices.js (which does fetch /api/clinics) but forgot to add the useState + useEffect. Repro: login as sarah → /appointments/<id>/prescription → click Add Medication → fill medicine_name → click [data-testid=print-prescription-btn] → console: 'ReferenceError: primaryClinic is not defined'. Fix: add `const [primaryClinic, setPrimaryClinic] = useState(null);` and a useEffect to GET /api/clinics and select is_primary || [0].
